issue: Initial reproduction attempt incorrectly treated panel/role digests as order-invariant set digests. The v0.1 design digests are instead hashes of the deterministic hash-ranked sequence itself.

resolution.domain_digest: SHA256 of lexicographically sorted 762-species domain joined by LF, no trailing LF
resolution.panel_and_role_digest: SHA256 of the deterministic hash-ranked species sequence joined by LF, no trailing LF
resolution.panel_key: SHA256('place-recurrence-insecta-fresh-v0.1|' + archive_sha256 + '|' + species), hexadecimal ascending; species tie-break
resolution.development_role_key: SHA256('place-recurrence-insecta-fresh-v0.1|development-role|' + archive_sha256 + '|' + species), hexadecimal ascending; species tie-break
resolution.confirmatory_role_key: SHA256('place-recurrence-insecta-fresh-v0.1|confirmatory-role|' + archive_sha256 + '|' + species), hexadecimal ascending; species tie-break

independent_response_blind_crosscheck.interpretation: The reproduced memberships generate the frozen response-blind information diagnostics and descriptive target counts. This establishes identity of the intended v0.1 design without genetic response.

correction_scope: Workflow/provenance digest semantics only. The v0.1 panel membership, roles, predictor, controls, gates and scientific hypothesis remain unchanged.
